title: Mother-in-Law NDE 3109
content: My name is George and I narrate the experience of my mother-in-law, whom I didn't know. My wife related the experience to me. I was particularly interested in NDE's, and on one occasion when I spoke with my wife on this theme, she relayed this experience of her mother. For me, the telling was truly stimulating because it provided direct evidence that the NDE experiences correspond to the transit time from one form of existence to another. My mother-in-law's pregnancy was the same as with the fourth child. Everything was normal, up until the delivery, during which a midwife tended to her. [Midwives] in Mexico are women who have learned through experience to attend deliveries; they're not doctors. The day of the delivery, the midwife attended my mother-in-law in her house; the baby was born - it was a girl. Hours later, my mother-in-law experienced a strong hemorrhaging connected to the delivery. At some point, my mother-in-law started to see a path strewn with flowers and light. At the end of the path, she saw an elderly lady. My mother-in-law reached the elderly lady, who told her to go back; that she should see her family who were suffering for her. The elderly lady showed my mother-in-law her husband and her small children around the bed and other persons. All were crying and praying for my mother-in-law; for they thought she was dying. My mother-in-law saw herself stretched out on the bed; she knew it was she (there). In that moment, she became conscious that she was out of her body. The answer of my mother-in-law to the elderly lady was that she wanted to go with her, because she felt such peace and tranquility. The elderly lady again told her that, no, she had to go back. My mother-in-law awoke in the bed and recuperated.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: She first perceived a flower-strewn path with light and an elderly lady, then was shown her family and her body on the bed and realized she was out of her body, then was told to return and awoke.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The guide showed her a scene of her husband, children, and others around her bed crying and praying, which led her to recognize she was out of her body.
